goal: Generate a public portrait of a CEO/business president of a global tech company, for use on summit guest walls, internal publication cover pages, and high-resolution LinkedIn images.

subject.gender: South Asian American male known to the public as the prototype of Sundar Pichai.
subject.appearance: Short hair, neatly parted, can wear rimless or semi-rimmed glasses, subtle smile
subject.outfit: Medium gray or charcoal gray single-breasted suit, light white shirt, no collar decoration, clean lining

expression.gaze: Gaze into the camera, both eyes evenly focused

composition.shot: 胸像，双手不出画或只露折叠袖口在画幅下缘
composition.framing: Standard centered to slightly left, leaving about one head height of white space at the top.

background.type: Uniform warm gray seamless background or extremely soft gradient, with no recognizable logo
background.depth_of_field: Medium shallow depth of field, background with a slight brightness change of 5% from center to edge is sufficient

lighting.key_light: Slightly left-oriented butterfly soft light, small symmetrical shadow below the nose.
lighting.fill_light: Bottom right low-angle weak fill, raised eye reflection point

style.rendering: Commercial studio high resolution, skin tone neutral without a reddish bias
style.post_processing: Remove blemishes while retaining moles and smile lines, overall contrast is restrained

must_keep: Attire matches the industry, no sportswear present.
No wearing of strong political or religious symbols
avoid: Closed posture with arms crossed (unless the user requests)
A discernible real Google logo wall appears at the edge of the image.
